QuestInfo.name: Jun's Thoughts
QuestInfo.0: No adult in #m310000000# seems approachable, but a child may be different. Talk to #b#p2152008##k, and see if you can find out why people aren't talking to you.
QuestInfo.1: Although the child gives you a little more reaction than any of the adults, #p2152008# isn't what you would call friendly. You wonder how you can befriend #p2152008#... Perhaps you can give #p2152008# a gift. He seems to dote on #bthe puppy he's carrying#k...
QuestInfo.2: After you gave him some delicious Dry Treats for his puppy, #p2152008# opened up to you. According to #p2152008#, keeping distance from outsiders doesn't seem to be a part of the town's culture. He says the townspeople just avoid people like you. You wonder what that means... You couldn't possibly be worse than the Black Wings.
